$comment: Declarative slice list for the Modern Interiors pack (LimeZu).
Paths are relative to pack_root. Geometry here is MEASURED, not assumed --
see tools/atlas/README.md for how each number was verified.
This file contains no pixels, only coordinates, so it is safe to commit.
The atlases it produces are NOT safe to commit; see .gitignore.
Layer order is the pack's documented BODY > EYES > OUTFIT > HAIRSTYLE >
ACCESSORY (CHARACTER_GENERATOR.txt). A premade collapses the first four,
so only the accessory is layered on top. Keeping this a list rather than a
single flattened file is what preserves the option of customization later.
$directions_comment: Column blocks run counter-clockwise from east: right, up, left, down.
Verified with the gift row, where the held box sits right of the body in
block 0 and left of it in block 2. Spec 14 claimed down/up/left/right;
using that order silently swaps the baker's facing.
